Question: If you have had unprotected sex the night before the abortion, can you still be pregnant after the abortion?
Answer: It is an interesting question. And the answer to the question is NO. How does woman become pregnant? The egg is released by the ovary. The sperms enter the uterus and reach out to the egg and fertilise it. These sperms can stay active for maximum 2 days. The fertilised egg settles inside the uterus which already has developed a lining to host this embyo. ( Source: Google) What is the effect of pregnancy? Once the woman is already pregnant, the mouth of the uterus gets blocked and does not allow entry of sperm. There is no ovulation or fresh egg generation. How does the process of abortion impact? It will take few days for ovulation to resume after few days post abortion. Till then the sperm will not stay alive. During the process of abortion , the lining of uterus is scraped as well. It will take few days for it to form and support pregnancy. For above reasons , one can not become pregnant due to intercourse done a day prior to abortion. Mind you intercourse done few days later can lead to pregnancy. This it is advisable to use contraceptive .

Medical reason: Lack of nutrition, care, substance abuse, general neglect all can definitely affect the health of the fetus. But none can directly be attributed to death of fetus. The relationship is not so direct. ( No Causa causans ) Most of the above adveresly affect the woman' s health too. So she is also a sufferer. Most of the above have deep rooted causes such as poverty, mal nutrition, lack of education, lack access to health care, male dominant society. In conclusion, not only the fetus but the woman as well is the victim and not perpetrator of neglect. Further pinning her down and putting this burden on her is adding injustice to her.

Question: As a surgeon, what is the most shocking thing you ever saw after opening somebody up?
Answer: I am an obstetrician and gynaecologist. I was performing an emergency C section at 2 am. It was a tough case of placenta praevia. These patients are known to bleed. As soon as i removed the baby out, i found a long thin tube like catheter coming out and i was dumbstuck. Such type of catheter is not used in our practice. And the woman had claimed that she had not undergone any surgery in the past. I did not know what was happening. Simultaneously there was ferocious bleeding happening. I controlled the bleeding. I tried to check from where the catheter was coming. It came from upper abdomen. My assistant started tugging on it. I sternly asked the woman (being in regional anaesthesia she could talk), if she was hiding anything from me. At that time she confessed that she had undergone a brain surgery called VP Shunting. Now i knew the origin of catheter. But because of non disclosure of this vital information, i was more worried as i had probably used wrong anaesthesia and not used appropriate antibiotics. Fortunately God was with me and everything went well. Moral of the story: Don't hide any information of past medical treatment from your doctor. Many a times patients think that it is irrelevant. But let your doctor decide what is relevant and what is not. Help the doctor so that he/ she can help you.

Question: Will a gynecologist doctor report to police if a teenager girl is pregnant and above 18?

In other words, a woman below 18 does not have the capacity to give legally valid consent for sexual intercourse as per Indian law ( POSCO Act). A doctor is duty bound to inform the police when the doctors knows that rape has laid to the pregnancy hence doctor needs to inform to the police. Thus, Pregnant woman above 18 , claims that she was a victim of rape and wants health care, doctor had to inform the police. Pregnant woman below 18, even if says that it was consensual, it will be treated as rape in legal terms and hence doctor should inform the police. Lastly, treatment especially when life saving MUST start immediately and police information can wait .

Question: Can I abort in 8 months?
Answer: I believe that the mother and only the mother should have unequivocal right to decide whether to give birth or not. I ( and many ethic organizations) believe that fetus in womb does not have right to life independent of the mother. However live birth is the event that changes this position and after the live birth the child has an independent right to live and MUST get protection under law. Note that I am using word “fetus” to refer to baby in the womb and “child” while referring to baby out of the womb. Most of the countries restrict late abortions though. Many countries allow abortions when there are very serious abnormalities in the fetus or if mother's life is at risk.((https://www.google.co.in/url?sa=t&source=web&rct=j&url=http://nuffieldbioethics.org/wp-content/uploads/2014/07/CCD-Chapter-4-Dilemmas-in-current-practice-the-fetus.pdf&ved=2ahUKEwi1z4yY6OHdAhXIu48KHYGZAVgQFjAAegQIABAB&usg=AOvVaw11PW-nzcvSmCBv29Eim7Ch) The procedure of late abortion is same as inducing labour. Especially after 24 weeks of gestation, the fetus is mature enough to sustain labour and would be born alive after the procedure. Thus irrespective of the intention ( the word abortion intends that the fetus should not survive), the baby would survive after birth. This would lead to an absurd situation… that one does a medical procedure to cause death of the fetus and actually a live baby is born out of it.To avoid this absurdity, sonography guided feticide is done before labour is induced. this procedure the doctor injects certain medicine in the heart of the fetus in the womb to stop it under sonography guidance. This ensures that the fetusis born dead. (https://www.google.co.in/url?sa=t&source=web&rct=j&url=https://www.rcog.org.uk/globalassets/documents/guidelines/terminationpregnancyreport18may2010.pdf&ved=2ahUKEwi5nsvW6OHdAhUPUI8KHRhoCLoQFjAAegQIABAB&usg=AOvVaw3Rtyp6LWkgb5oHS_7boSVL) Thus the procedure of late termination becomes complex . There is no data that shows that it increases the risk to the mother as compared to the risk in natural childbirth, to my knowledge, when done in legitimate manner. In short, later termination should be practically considered only when pressing reasons are there such as high risk to the mother or severe abnormality to the fetus. In India , I am spearheading rhe judicial activism around this issue, I have helped more than 50 women to obtain permission from the courts to terminate as indian law ( MTP Act) allows termination only upto 20 weeks.Dr Nikhil Datar: Mumbai Heroes This work towards women's rights for abortion is done free of cost and have paved way to the probable amendment of the law in India.

Question: What is the procedure of taking pregnancy test step by step?
Answer: Thanks for A2A. Science behind the test: The test detects presence of pregnancy hormone beta HCG in urine. If the hormone is present in blood in sufficient amount only then it will come in urine. There are very few conditions which produce this hormone in the body, pregnancy being the most common cause. Timing of the test: Wait for atleast 5 days after missing the period. Urine sample collected in the morning is preferred but not mandatory. Urine collection: Collect urine in any dry and clean container. Check the urine pregnancy kit The card kit is better than strips ( which are less available any ways). Check the kit for expiry , read instructions on the card. Open it only when you are ready with collected urine. If the card gets dried it can give erroneous results. The test: Use a dropper to put 3 drops of urine in the well on the card. Check for 2 lines at C and T. If both lines are present the test is positive which means the HCG hormone is present which means that the woman is pregnant. One dark and one faint line This could be evaporation line. It means that the kit has dried and showing faint pink line. This could also be the case if the value of hormone is less… usually if the test is done too early. So repeat the test after few days. Important questions: 1 Can one get positive test when not pregnant? 2 Does the positive test mean that it is a good pregnancy? No it means that one is pregnant. It may still land up into miscarriage if that is destined. 3 Can male have this test positive? Never unless erroneous test . There are few cancers which can cause this hormone. In such case the test can come positive. 4 Can one test pet’s urine for pregnancy on this kit? No. The animals, even if pregnant, do not produce HUMAN chorionic gonadotropin. So the test cannot be used.

Question: How is the expiry date given to medicines? Suppose a medicine has an expiry date of 31/07/18. Is it safe to consume it now (18/7/18)?

Does it mean that the medicine “expires”/ vanishes/ decays suddenly at 12 midnight when the 31st gets over and 1st August begins? Of course NO. Expiry date is the date upto which the manufacturer guarantees that the contents of the medicine stay as effective as they were on 1st day of manufacturing. It is a myth that after expiry the medicine will decay/ rot/ turn poisonous. Most of the medicines may stay effective even after expiry date but no manufacturer is going to vouch for it. So I don't recommend use of post expiry medicine but if consumed it is not likely to harm.. it may not be as effective though.
